It punishes slower combat armies and horde infantry that can't survive Fights First pressure backed by high-volume melee output. It struggles against gunlines and alpha-strike lists that strip the Rhino transports before the charge lands, leaving the melee core exposed and reactive.
572: Built around Purestrain Genestealers, Aberrants, the Abominant, and waves of Neophyte Hybrids and Acolyte Hybrids, this list runs Biosanctic Broodsurge to supercharge its melee horde — charging units gain +1 to charge rolls and +1 Attacks on the fight, turning already-dangerous blobs into explosive kill-engines. The plan is to crash multiple large units into the midboard simultaneously, overwhelming defenders through sheer volume of boosted attacks while Neophyte Hybrids heal three wounds per Command phase inside terrain to anchor objectives. Achilles Ridgerunners and the Reductus Saboteur provide mobile threat projection that punishes lightly armoured, spread-out lists that can't handle fighting across multiple threat vectors at once. Tight screens, elite chaff-clearers, and anything that denies charges or forces fights-first crack it open before the melee engine ever connects.
754: Built around Grand Masters in Nemesis Dreadknights, Paladin Squads, Strike Squads, Interceptor Squads, and Purifier Squads, this is a hyper-mobile all-rounder that leverages the Sanctic Spearhead detachment's core rule to turbo-charge Dreadknights — skipping the Advance roll entirely for a flat +6" move while keeping their ranged weapons firing on Assault. Highly mobile elite forces that can collapse individual Purifier squads — breaking Hallowed Ground coverage — and armies with sufficient long-range firepower to strip Dreadknights before they engage will crack this list open.
740: Built around Deathwatch Kill Teams, Watch Masters, Imperial Navy Breachers, and Subductor Squads packed into Rhinos and Immolators, this is a mass-horde gunline that floods the board with cheap, mission-capable infantry across every Imperial subfaction simultaneously. It punishes low-model-count elite armies that cannot trade efficiently into waves of screening infantry reinforced by layered lethal rules and skimmer-mobile fire platforms. Aggressive alpha-strike armies that can delete transports before they disembark and volume armies that out-horde the horde can crack this open before the hit-bonus engine comes online.
756: Built around multiple Grand Masters in Nemesis Dreadknights, Purgation Squads, Purifier Squads, and Castellan Crowe, this list runs either Fires of Purgation or Warpbane Task Force to layer psychic shooting pressure across the board. The plan is to pin enemy units with Righteous Persecution, forcing battle-shock rolls at -1, while Dreadknights threaten mobile anti-armour and Purifiers extend Hallowed Ground to contest mid-table objectives under favorable conditions. It punishes horde-heavy armies hardest, where massed psychic firepower and battle-shock cascades can strip bodies and deny actions simultaneously. It cracks open against elite low-model-count armies that shrug off battle-shock and can surgically remove Purgation Squads before the pinning engine comes online.
761: Built around Armiger Helverins, Armiger Warglaives, and a Knight Crusader, this list runs Throne-Bonded Outriders paired with Valourstrike Lance to field a fast, all-armour hunting party. 522: Built around four squads of Cthonian Beserks deep striking across the board, supported by Berehk Stornbröw, Einhyr Hearthguard, Ûthar the Destined, Hernkyn Pioneers, Yaegirs, Kapricus Carriers, Memnyr Strategist, and Hekaton Land Fortresses, this is a mass-horde brawler that floods the midfield from multiple angles simultaneously. 579: Built around Doomsday Arks, Canoptek Wraiths, Skorpekh Lords and Destroyers, Ophydian Destroyers, Flayed Ones, Hexmark Destroyers, Imotekh, Canoptek Reanimators, and Technomancers operating under Awakened Dynasty's +1 to Hit for CHARACTER-led units, this is a highly mobile toolbox army that floods the board with fast, resilient threats across every phase. 767: Built around Ghazghkull Thraka, multiple Boyz mobs, Painboys, Warboss characters, Wazdakka Gutsmek, Zodgrod Wortsnagga, and Flash Gitz, with Gretchin screening and Kommandos scouting forward 6" via Equatorial Hordes, this is a wall-of-bodies pressure list running two detachments to layer utility across the entire army. 783: Built around Deathshroud Terminators, Lords of Contagion, Poxwalkers, Plague Marines, Tallymen, Foetid Bloat-Drones, and Lords of Virulence, this is a grinding attrition force that floods the board with layered lethality across multiple unit types.
